title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1971-12-10
lineage: Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) -> Dat (Sony R500) -> Samplitude Professional v9.11 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a hot first set with standout Bertha, Tennessee Jed and Big Railroad Blues – the second set is missing.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑salvaged recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard quality that fans rave about as “clean” and “great”. The available first set burns with high energy, highlighted by Bertha, Tennessee Jed and a rousing Big Railroad Blues, though listeners note the absence of the second set and missing track labels. Overall the performance is praised despite these incompleteness issues.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars, praising the clean sound and strong first‑set performance; a single low rating notes missing track labels and the second set is absent, tempering the overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, well‑balanced soundboard capture praised as “great” and “better than other sources". Missing second set and lack of track labels are noted drawbacks.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the first set is present, delivering a tight, high‑energy snapshot of the early Keith Godchaux/Pigpen era.

band_member_comments.Keys: Positive reference to the early Keith Godchaux era, indicating strong keyboard presence.
